title: A Realized One Both Still Exists and No Longer Exists
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 24.17 Linked Discourses 24.17
  • 1. Sotāpattivagga 1. Stream-Entry

Hoticanacahotitathāgatosutta A Realized One Both Still Exists and No Longer Exists

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Kismiṁ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṁ upādāya, kiṁ abhinivissa evaṁ diṭṭhi uppajjati: “Mendicants, when what exists, because of grasping what and insisting on what, does the view arise: ‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’”ti? ‘A realized one both still exists and no longer exists after death’?” …

“Bhagavaṁmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā …pe… niyato sambodhiparāyano”ti.

Sattarasamaṁ.
